name: ADR 0001 - Git is the plan, not a controller
description: Portfolio-wide: git is the source of truth and the record, not a continuously reconciling controller; drift is made visible and corrected on purpose.
content:
# ADR 0001 - Git is the plan, not a controller

## Status
Accepted

## Context
The previous homelab cluster looked installed while the running cluster quietly diverged from git: only one app was genuinely reconciled, real data sat in hand-rolled pets, and half the secrets were hand-seeded. Across the portfolio the same pattern recurs - branches rot when work does not merge, and drift hides when controllers silently self-heal. Auto-reconciliation made the gap invisible instead of actionable.

## Decision
Git is the source of truth and the record, not a continuously reconciling controller. State changes only through git, then a deliberate apply (Helmfile, kubectl, OpenTofu). We do not run GitOps selfHeal by default; drift is made visible (diff, k8sgpt, fleet conformance scans) and corrected on purpose, never auto-healed away. Prefer changes that land over branches that rot - one coherent PR that merges beats five that stall.

## Consequences
- No selfHeal by default; the discipline is visibility plus deliberate apply.
- Every system must be rebuildable from its repo (node OS included for the homelab).
- Drift is a signal to act on, not noise to suppress.
- Landing work matters more than branch size.
- Source: coldaine-k8cluster ADR 0002 and NORTH_STAR goal 3; reinforced by the portfolio control service and agent-control-plane promotion discipline.

name: ADR 0002 - Advisory agents never block merge
description: Portfolio-wide: review agents add signal to PRs but never edit code or block merge; blocking escalation is opt-in and off by default.
content:
# ADR 0002 - Advisory agents never block merge

## Status
Accepted

## Context
NorthStarGuardian and PRAgent both exist to add signal to pull requests, not to gate humans. Hidden merge authority erodes trust and lets agents silently become product owners. The same risk applies to any future agent that touches the review flow.

## Decision
Review agents are advisory by default. They record, explain, and route follow-up work; they do not edit files, commit, push, open PRs, or block merge. Blocking escalation is opt-in and off by default (Guardian enable_blocking_escalation defaults to false; PRAgent enforces advisory-only via permissions, hooks, and validators). Agents post exactly one readable PR comment and update it in place. Agent identities use GitHub App installation tokens, not human PATs, so agents never masquerade as a user.

## Consequences
- Humans keep merge authority.
- Drift and debt records are signals, not hard blocks, unless explicitly configured.
- Each agent gets its own GitHub App identity and scope.
- Scanners stay deterministic and outside agents; adaptable reasoning stays inside bounded agents.
- Sources: NorthStarGuardian principles p2 and ap3; PRAgent NORTH_STAR goals and docs/components/08-advisory-only-enforcement.md.

name: ADR 0003 - Transcripts are ground truth; repos hold distilled learnings
description: Portfolio-wide four-tier authority: transcripts on disk are ground truth; agent-control-plane holds distilled learnings; skills hold promoted procedures; project repos hold only product facts.
content:
# ADR 0003 - Transcripts are ground truth; repos hold distilled learnings

## Status
Accepted

## Context
Agent sessions produce huge volumes of text. Pasting raw session dumps into project repos pollutes product authority docs (NORTH_STAR, architecture, ADRs) and loses the link back to what was actually said and done. At the same time, lessons that recur across projects need a place to accumulate and promote into reusable procedures.

## Decision
A four-tier authority order governs agent learning across the portfolio:
1. Transcripts on disk (Cursor, Codex, Claude jsonl) are ground truth for what was said and done.
2. agent-control-plane holds distilled learnings with links back to transcript IDs, plus a promotion queue.
3. frozenSkillz and ~/.agents/skills hold promoted, actionable procedures.
4. Project repos hold only facts about the product or system itself.
Raw session dumps never get pasted into product repos. Learnings use stable IDs (LRN-YYYYMMDD-NNN) so catalog entries and promotion queues can track them. Retrospectives run on any project and write back to agent-control-plane.

## Consequences
- Project authority docs stay clean and product-focused.
- Cross-project themes are searchable in one catalog.
- Cluster or infra facts promote to the project ADR or docs/history of that project only.
- Reusable process rules promote to skills; durable product facts promote to project ADRs.
- Source: agent-control-plane README authority order and AGENTS.md.

name: ADR 0004 - Secrets fail loud; no secret values in git
description: Portfolio-wide: Doppler is the canonical secrets store; git holds sync references only; a missing secret stops the deploy rather than inventing a default.
content:
# ADR 0004 - Secrets fail loud; no secret values in git

## Status
Accepted

## Context
Hand-seeded secrets and silent fallbacks caused real failures in the previous homelab cluster. Hardcoding keys in config files is fragile across a fleet and makes rotation and audit painful. The same risk applies to any tool that calls paid provider APIs (ColdSearch) or third-party model runtimes.

## Decision
Doppler is the canonical secrets store. Runtime mirrors are materialized by External Secrets Operator into the homelab (ADR 0013), or injected as environment variables for tools like ColdSearch. No secret values live in git - only sync references (ExternalSecret, ClusterSecretStore, doppler: refs). A missing secret stops the deploy rather than inventing a default. SOPS or an offline vault covers cluster recovery. Agents and tools must not log secret values.

## Consequences
- Git holds references only; secret values stay in Doppler or SOPS for recovery.
- Missing or wrong secrets surface immediately, not months later.
- Provider key pools and rotation are managed centrally.
- ColdSearch reads normal env vars and must never log secret values.
- Sources: coldaine-k8cluster NORTH_STAR goal 5 and ADR 0013; ColdSearch architecture invariant on Doppler for secret injection.
